release_name: Movies: find, download and organize movies automatically
highlights: New Movies page and four movie jobs (library scan, discovery, search, downloads) using the existing indexers, download clients, TMDb credential and Plex servers

New digital and Blu-ray releases that pass rating, vote, language and genre filters are added, searched (movie categories, IMDb ID first) and sent under a movies category or label; completed files are renamed to Title (Year)/Title (Year).ext and Plex scans the folder
Failed or stalled releases are blocklisted and another is searched; owned movies in Plex or the movie folder are never downloaded again; a replaced file goes to the share trash
